text: このさきは　してんのうと　ひとりずつ　たたかうの！

structure.jp: ひとりずつ　たたかうの！
structure.en: you fight one at a time!

patterns.name: 〜ずつ
patterns.explanation: ずつ after an amount means that amount each time. ひとりずつ = 'one person at a time'.

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a sentence gives a soft, explaining tone, heard often in women's speech. たたかうの = 'you fight, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜と (with)
patterns.explanation: と after a person shows who you do the action with or against. してんのうと　ひとりずつ　たたかう = 'fight against the Elite Four one at a time'.
